build_DeformNetwork: build a DeformNetwork module with configurable depth, width, and 6DOF deformation mode
create_Embedder: create an Embedder instance with log sampling and sin/cos periodic functions for positional encoding
run_get_embedder: run get_embedder to create a positional encoding function and get its output dimension
review_DeformNetwork_forward: review the DeformNetwork forward pass that returns deformation, rotation, and scaling outputs
test_Embedder_embed: test the Embedder embed method to concatenate frequency-banded sin/cos embeddings on input tensors
